title: Werewolf and Vampire Datapack: Creatures of the Night
description: Adds superbly powerful single-person endgame transformations into the Werewolf or the Vampire.
body:
Info

This datapack adds the possibility for players to become a Werewolf or a Vampire.


Create an altar using blackstone bricks and gold blocks in a 3x3 pattern with the gold block in the middle surrounded by blackstone bricks.

To begin the ritual, throw a dragon egg onto the gold.

Then, once you are imbued with the dragon egg, choose-

Throw bone onto the gold to become the Werewolf.

Throw bone meal onto the gold to become the Vampire.


The Vampire-

The Vampire is a depraved beast that thrives on control and domination. Imbued with sorcerous demonic powers, it can harness deadly plagues, freeze enemies in their tracks, levitate into the air, teleport, and shroud itself in a cloud of bloody mist. It is weakened by both water and fire, but otherwise is completely invulnerable and able to use abilities limitlessly after having recently feasted on human blood.

Abilities:

Hotbar Slot 7: Levitation

Sneak to rise slowly into the air. While on this slot, gain the Slow Falling status effect, allowing descents from any height with no damage. Can be used at any hunger level.

Hotbar slot 8: Incorporeality

Select this slot to be shrouded in a cloud of bloody mist. While on this slot, become invisible to mobs and gain an extreme boost to speed and jump height, but lose the ability attack. This slot rapidly drains the hunger bar. Cannot be used on low hunger.

Hotbar slot 9: Plague

Sneak to cover the surrounding 8 block radius in a deadly plague-inducing blight. Entities in the affected area are slowed to a stop, withered, nauseated, and infested, periodically spawning Silverfish. This slot rapidly drains the hunger bar. Cannot be used on low hunger.

Main Ability-

While above 6 hunger, the Vampire is completely invulnerable to any and all damage. Any damage recieved will instead be transferred to the hunger bar, which will always take a fixed 3 damage from any attack despite its actual damage. Also while above 6 hunger, the Vampire has permanent Strength III.

Notes:

-All food items excluding raw meat will disappear from inventory.

-Hunger can be recovered by killing any mob.

-After killing a villager, gain saturation for 30 minutes. This saturation will be disabled if entering water, or being lit on fire.

-Being submerged in water inflicts Weakness, Slowness, Hunger, and disables all buffs including invulnerability.

-Sprinting grants enormous Speed.

-Will automatically teleport to a random nearby spot when fired at with Arrows.

-Permanent night vision.


The Werewolf-


The Werewolf is a beastly manifestation of hunger, perpetually gnawing from within its host as it seeks to break free and consume all that it can. A force of nature, it possesses strength, speed, toughness, and a boundless ferocity that allows it to strengthen when angered. A creature of calamity, its very presence can trigger Raids. Though it can be subdued with extreme and valiant force, it has no weaknesses.

Abilities:

Main Ability-

Hotbar slot 9: Transform

At full health (20 in human form, 40 in wolf form), sneak to transform.


The transformation:

When turning from human to wolf, gain double max health, Strength, Jump Boost, Speed, and Resistance. Transforming into wolf form will destroy all equipped armor. Become inflicted with Bad Omen for one hour upon transforming into wolf form. In wolf form, become harder to detect (since you are technically invisible). Killing mobs fills up the hunger bar. Taking any damage grants enhanced strength and speed for a few seconds immediately afterwards. Killing a villager grants more satiation than other mobs. Dealing any damage grants saturation.

When transforming back into human form, take damage.

Notes-
-Transforming back into human form fully clears all temporary effects, both positive and negative.
-The Werewolf is much larger than a normal wolf. Third person makes it easier to interact with the world while in wolf form.
-All armor equipped in wolf form will be instantly destroyed.
-The Werewolf is unidentifiable while in wolf form.
-Every single hit scored against enemies grants saturation.
-The Werewolf automatically steps up one block.

There is no cure. These are permanent decisions. Only one Werewolf and one Vampire can exist at once. Who will try their luck?
